{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
n_missing_baseline = len(data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999])
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {n_missing_baseline}')

# Count unique patient_id values
n_unique_patients = data['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Number of unique patient_id values: {n_unique_patients}')

# Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
filtered_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Count duplicate patient_id entries after filtering
n_duplicate_ids = filtered_data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries after filtering: {n_duplicate_ids}')

# Identify patients with multiple sample_seq entries
sample_seq_max = filtered_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
retested_patients = len(sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1])
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {retested_patients}')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
final_data = filtered_data.loc[filtered_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
n_patients = len(final_data)
print(f'Final number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')"}
